# `vllm-vcr play` flags the translator emits.
#
# One bare long-form flag per line, in the exact spelling the simulator binary
# accepts. This is the operator's half of the upstream check: it is validated
# against the code by TestPlayFlagSurfaceMatchesDeclaration
# (internal/translator/playflags_test.go) and against the pinned simulator release
# by hack/check-vllm-vcr-upstream.sh (docs/upstream-vllm-vcr.md).
#
# The injected Python frontend's `vllm serve` flags are not listed here.
--control-address
--enable-kv-cache-events
--engine-id
--expect-config-hash
--handshake-address
--kv-cache-size
--kv-events-endpoint
--kv-events-topic
--latency-trace
--log-requests
--long-prefill-token-threshold
--max-loras
--max-model-len
--max-num-batched-tokens
--max-num-seqs
--model-name
--pd-role
--replay-match
--replay-tokens
--scheduling-policy
--seed
--shutdown-timeout
--tokens-per-block
